Slow coffee for fast mornings

Single-estate Chikmagalur beans, roasted every Tuesday behind the counter and poured to order on 12th Main, Indiranagar.

See today’s menu Find us
Scroll to pour

From a hillside in Chikmagalur to the cup in your hand, in nine days.

We buy from three estates we visit every harvest, roast in small batches, and never sell a bag that left the roaster more than three weeks ago.

1

Grown in shade

Arabica from Baba Budangiri, grown at 1,400 m under silver oak and pepper vines. Hand-picked, only the ripe red cherry.

Altitude
1,200–1,500 m
Harvest
Nov – Feb
2

Roasted on Tuesdays

Twelve-kilo batches on our drum roaster, profiled for each lot. Light for the slow bar, medium for milk drinks.

Batch size
12 kg
Rest before brewing
5–7 days
3

Poured to order

Dialled in every morning at 7. Weighed doses, filtered water, milk steamed for each cup, never re-heated.

Espresso
18 g in, 38 g out
Milk
Steamed to 62 °C
